instruction: Put the yellow mug in the purple box.

attempts.code:
obs = observe()
mug = obs["objects"]["yellow_mug"]
zone = obs["zones"]["purple_box"]

# Check if purple_box is occupied
occupied = False
for o_name, o in obs["objects"].items():
    if (abs(o["center"][0] - zone["center"][0]) < zone["half_size"][0] + 0.01 and
        abs(o["center"][1] - zone["center"][1]) < zone["half_size"][1] + 0.01 and
        o["top_z"] < zone["center"][2] + 0.01 and o_name != "yellow_mug"):
        occupied = True
        break

if occupied:
    # Move the occupying object to cyan_tray if possible
    cyan_tray = obs["zones"]["cyan_tray"]
    for o_name, o in obs["objects"].items():
        if (abs(o["center"][0] - zone["center"][0]) < zone["half_size"][0] + 0.01 and
            abs(o["center"][1] - zone["center"][1]) < zone["half_size"][1] + 0.01 and
            o["top_z"] < zone["center"][2] + 0.01 and o_name != "yellow_mug"):
            pick(o_name, 0.02, o["long_axis_yaw"])
            place("cyan_tray")
            break

# Pick the yellow mug with grasp_height 0.08 and yaw = short_axis_yaw
pick("yellow_mug", 0.08, mug["short_axis_yaw"])
# Place on purple_box with small offset to ensure full inside
place("purple_box", dx=0.01, dy=-0.01)
